I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the current deadline for the signed Tamsin Cold Chain order form is **24 September**.

- **How it got there:** On 14 Oct Ilse posted 20 November in #north-team. The same morning she corrected it in #north-random to 24 September, saying she had read the wrong line. Dana is a member of #north-random, so she can see that correction herself. I told her my earlier "20 November" reply in #north-team is out of date.
- **Not settled yet:** 24 September is already past. When Ilse posted the correction I asked her to confirm the year, and she hasn't answered. I told Dana to check with Ilse before putting the date in the tracker as final.

A deadline date is an operational fact, not a money figure, so the finance rule didn't apply.
